sec: Fever in infections: pattern by day, investigations, day-4 empirical therapy

items.q: Pattern of fever — match the infection to the printed pattern — 1) Salmonella 2) Malaria 3) Leptospirosis / scrub typhus … A) Chills and rigors with fatigue B) Myalgia of the calf muscles and conjunctival suffusion in a farmer C) Step-ladder / rising pattern
items.exp: '· Salmonella : Step ladder / Rising pattern. · malaria : Chills and rigors a/w fatigue. · Leptospirosis, scrub typhus : A/w myalgia (Calf muscle), conjunctival suffusion in a farmer'. (Book p1053)

items.q: Which occupation is printed in the leptospirosis / scrub typhus fever-pattern line?
items.exp: 'Leptospirosis, scrub typhus : A/w myalgia (Calf muscle), conjunctival suffusion in a farmer'. (Book p1053)

items.q: Dengue fever — match the symptom group — 1) Grade of fever 2) Pain 3) Gastrointestinal … A) High grade B) Vomiting, described as a few episodes C) Retro-orbital and occipital pain
items.exp: '· Dengue : - High grade fever a/w : a. Retro-orbital pain, b. Occipital pain, c. vomiting'. (Book p1053)

items.q: Which is NOT printed among the pains of dengue on this page?
items.exp: Printed: retro-orbital pain and occipital pain with vomiting. (Book p1053)

items.q: Which investigation is printed first in the fever work-up?
Fill up (Malaria testing): 'Quantitative buffy coat (QBC), repeated every ______ hours.'
items.exp: '· malaria : Quantitative buffy coat (QBC). Repeated every 12 hours'. (Book p1053)

items.q: How many consecutive negative QBC tests does the page require before malaria is ruled out?
items.exp: 'Ruled out : If 3 consecutive tests negative'. (Book p1053)

items.q: What does the page advise starting on day 4 of fever?
opts: Doxycycline (100 mg BD) plus co-trimoxazole double strength BD
items.exp: 'Fever on day 4 : Start on : Doxycycline (100mg BD) + Cotrimoxazole DS (Double strength) BD'. (Book p1053)

items.q: The day-4 empirical regimen is printed as covering which infections?
items.exp: Under the day-4 regimen the page prints 'Leptospirosis, Scrub typhus'. (Book p1053)

items.q: Judge the fever algorithm: I Malaria is excluded only after three consecutive negative QBC tests. II By day 4 the page starts doxycycline plus double-strength co-trimoxazole for leptospirosis and scrub typhus.
items.exp: 'Ruled out : If 3 consecutive tests negative' and 'Fever on day 4 : Start on : Doxycycline (100mg BD) + Cotrimoxazole DS BD'. (Book p1053)

items.q: How is the fever evaluation organised on this page?
opts: Day by day — fever on day 1-2, day 3, day 4 and day 5
Only by the height of the fever
items.exp: The synopsis is headed 'Fever in Infections' and then organised as 'Fever on day 1-2', 'Fever on day 3', 'Fever on day 4' and 'Fever on day 5'. (Book p1053)
